description:

Break results down by campaign, insertion order, line item, or creative. Compare performance, calculate click-through rates, and review daily delivery to understand how your programmatic advertising is performing.

publication.release_notes: Explore Display & Video 360 media cost, impressions, and clicks. Compare reporting periods, review campaign performance, and track daily media cost in conversation.

prompts: What was our DV360 media cost in USD for the 30 days ending two days ago in DV360 Demo?
Show DV360 impressions, clicks, and click-through rate for the 30 days ending two days ago in DV360 Demo.
Show DV360 media cost in USD by campaign for the 30 days ending two days ago in DV360 Demo.
Compare DV360 media cost in USD for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days in DV360 Demo.

positive.description: Media cost in USD. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to DV360 Demo and its Demo Display & Video 360 account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone at review time. The recent 30-day interval is [D-31, D-2], inclusive, and the preceding interval is [D-61, D-32]. Recalculate dates when testing. The final date is two calendar days before the current date. Expected numbers must come from the returned rows, not historical preparation notes.
positive.prompt: What was our DV360 media cost in USD for the 30 days ending two days ago in DV360 Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Select workspace_name=DV360 Demo using list_workspace and discover exact fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_dv360. Call retrieve_reporting_data with only the necessary fields in assorted_requests.dv360_request. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Inspect all model-visible reportingData tables, headers, date segments and note_of_assumption values. State the actual dates. Distinguish Media cost (USD) from Total media cost, Billable cost and Revenue; do not substitute one for another. Use unrounded returned values for calculations and round monetary display values to two decimals. If the API returns no rows, report no returned data rather than inventing activity. Errors and missing access are not successful report execution. Request metrics=[Media cost (USD)], no breakdowns or time_granularity, and date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]]. Report the returned media cost and explicitly label it USD. Do not present it as an all-in bill, sales revenue, or ROAS.

negative.description: Unsupported delivery change. Explain that this plugin reports DV360 data and cannot pause line items. Do not call reporting, preview, workspace, catalog or preference tools as a substitute for the requested change, and do not claim any line item was paused.
negative.prompt: Pause all active DV360 line items in DV360 Demo.

negative.description: Unsupported budget write. Explain that this plugin cannot change insertion-order budgets. Do not invoke reporting or preference tools to pretend to make the update, and do not claim any budget changed.

negative.description: Unsupported person-level identification. Explain that the reporting plugin cannot identify individual ad clickers or provide their email addresses. Do not retrieve unrelated reports, call preference tools, or invent personal identities.
